change_reason: Owner correctly challenged the hard 20x ceiling: if the frozen probability is credible, higher decimal odds increase expected return. Replace the hard ceiling with stricter band-specific evidence margins while preserving flat stake and no hindsight.

fixed_model_and_selection.model: S0 beta 0.22260435254784533 plus frozen PRE-only challenger
fixed_model_and_selection.top1_confidence_gate: S0/challenger agree top1 and conservative top1 probability >=0.40
fixed_model_and_selection.conservative_ticket_probability: min(S0 ticket probability, challenger ticket probability)

odds_policy.principle: Higher odds are never rejected merely because they are high. The purchase test is guarded expected value under the frozen conservative probability.
